如果说有什么小体量的游戏可以称之为神作，《武士零》绝对值得。
不同于肉鸽，《武士零》在线性关卡中做的很好。策略玩法被很好的融入了动作游戏，初上手我把他当做2D简洁版只狼，潜行策略弹反一刀秒很增加成就感，有点像死亡细胞都盾反，子弹时间的合理使用又让我想起了马克思佩恩，大大降低了游戏的上手难度，手残玩家落泪。 故事讲得很好，反战题材作品，有很好的哲学思想。同时游戏配乐也是这款游戏的加分项，赛博朋克+武士+像素，实在是不可多得。 可惜游戏的流程太短了，打完隐藏仍然意犹未尽，期待续作的表现。
最关键的一点，游戏在开发的时候就有意避开了数值膨胀。因为主角是一击必杀，受击也是一击必杀，决定了这款游戏没有什么可以提升上限的手段，你没有更多的血瓶、没有更高的攻击、没有更牛逼的道具，没有轮椅，所以除了苦练以及策略，游戏基本上没有可以称得上速通的办法，没有风灵月影，是这款游戏最特殊的存在。

I have to admit that I bought this game solely because of the positive reviews, which was a mistake I learned afterward.

In my opinion, Katana Zero is nothing more than a basic platformer with an simple and generic gameplay. It isn’t even difficult enough to offer a real challenge. If you have ever played a 2D combat platformer before (even if it was just an old Flash game) you won't find anything new here.

As for the story, although it features one interesting plot twist for a video game, the writing feels like it was done by a 12-year-old who watched too many R-rated movies. I won't tell any spoilers but what can I say is that it mixes random elements together into a narrative that becomes overly complicated just for the sake of it, before ultimately falling back on cheap, unoriginal clichés just to escape its own messy plot. Yeah, nice try, but that is not good storytelling.

The soundtrack is also completely forgettable for me personally, except perhaps for the one track during the ending. But even this track fails to support either the characters' emotions or what is actually happening during the gameplay.

All in all, Katana Zero has nothing truly special that makes it stand out from other 2D platformers. If you are fine with that, you might have some fun and perhaps even be impressed by the single plot twist I mentioned. However, anyone else who, like me, was looking for something truly great will be disappointed. I cannot recommend it.
